original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target literally with target-selection.json:/full_target and mathematically with problem.md:19-48. The approved, disclosed interpretation is support of u-q with one fixed q and a common compact spatial set on each closed positive time interval; it is preserved verbatim, not recast as literal compact support of a sphere-valued map. The parameter types supply only n,m,u,q, with positivity, smoothness, the unit constraints, pointwise normality, and support all retained in H001-H006 with original locations. H005 is only pointwise existential normality and assumes no regularity of its scalar. H003 (|q|=1) is retained but unused; the proof needs q to be fixed, which is part of H006 and the parameter declaration. D001 states the componentwise Laplacian, mixed-derivative notation, Euclidean/Frobenius conventions and Lebesgue measure; D002 has exactly e=|u_t|^2+sum_j|∂_ju|^2, without 1/2. D003 has exactly E(t)=∫e(x,t)dx on (0,∞) and is guarded by N002, which proves integrability before any E use. R003 and R005 take N002 directly; R001,R002,R004 do not use E. The graph is an acyclic AND graph with unique producers R001→N001, R002→N002, R003→N003, R004→N004, R005→P. Every retained M and N lies in P's backward dependency closure, and all six H remain initial nodes. The five proof units preserve problem.md:52-159, including the optional explicit-equation calculation in R001/S003 and the final constancy argument in R005/S003; no material passage has been omitted. The Evans second-edition exercise citation in problem.md:5-15 is supplied problem provenance, not an imported theorem used as a premise. The substantial invoked tools are the four actual pinned, successfully probed Mathlib theorems: M001 is the filter form of dominated convergence at DominatedConvergence.lean:66-74; M002 is Fubini at Prod.lean:438-445; M003 is FTC at FundThmCalculus.lean:1146-1151; M004 is the HasDerivAt mean value theorem at MeanValue.lean:120-127. I compared the full printed signatures and these source sections with their proposition statements: M001 includes countable generation and eventual/a.e. premises; M002 includes both s-finite measures; M003 includes completeness and endpoint derivatives; M004 includes strict order, continuity and interior derivatives. No unavailable literature theorem, unverified-primary assumption or fabricated source evidence is used. Structural validation and these same-author inspections are separate from independent Audit A acceptance.
